The Upgrade to Deluxe edition bundle includes the following content:

The Wanderer Set, including :

  • “Valente” Outfit

  • “Pathfinder” Backpack

  • “Blanket Roll” Backpack Attachment

Plus:

  • Lip Scar Character Cosmetic

  • Finger Gun Rapid Fire Emote

  • Scrappy Body Type and Outfit

  • 2 400 Raider Tokens

Raider Tokens are an in-game currency in ARC Raiders. Raider Tokens can be used to get raider decks, bundles, or other cosmetic items, including outfits, backpacks, charms, emotes, Scrappy outfits, etc.
